notes.title: Our new game Prognostic is available in Early Access
notes.content:
Our team has been working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1671280/Prognostic/]Prognostic [/url]for over a year and now you can finally play it. In this mystical horror, you will be able to solve crimes through communication with spirits. 

Every evening you will be sent a new case, which you can solve with the help of ancient rites (such as Tarot, dowsing, runes and others). Various fortune-telling rituals give their own clues, so you determine the course of the investigation. But remember — contact with spirits may draw some unwanted attention. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1671280/Prognostic/]Hurry up to grab Prognostic with a 21% Halloween discount! [/url]

notes.title: Week of updates - Final day
notes.content: During last week every day we tried to add in the game something new, and today will not be an exception. In this challenge you'll meet a new enemy, ghostly raven. It can go right through the obstacles, so now you must worry not only about spikes, but also - constant danger that lurks behind your back.

notes.title: Week of updates - Wednesday
notes.content:
Week of updates is coming to an end and then we'll take a short brake, but right now you can meet [b]two new levels[/b]. We hope that you a pretty good with a bees because one of today's challenges will definitely test it. Have fun! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33918856/82e6f1aecdc6e9eaaf5b382489bb808f6e21e2f2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Tuesday Update
notes.content: Week of the updates continues - new level is already in the game!

notes.title: New update: Two new levels
notes.content: Today's update adds two new levels to the game and completely unlocks all of them, so now you can finish levels in any order. Send us your opinions and suggestions - this will help us to make Give Me Your Coins better. Have fun!

notes.title: We are shifting update
notes.content:
Right before posting today's update, we found an error in the code. This bug closes all open levels after new levels has been added (all high-scores remain untouched).
No one likes when their progress in the game is erased due to some kind of error, so we decided to postpone the addition of new levels to the game until we locate this bug and fix it.
The estimated date of the new update is Monday. Thank you for understanding.

notes.title: Two levels on Sunday
notes.content: We are going to take a little rest, so no new updates for today. But tomorrow we'll make up for this with two new levels. Have a nice weekend!

notes.title: It's a new day, it's a new level
notes.content: Second day is coming to an end and we present you our second update. This level is a bit tricky and needs a special approach if you want to complete it with a great time. We hope you'll like it.

notes.title: Week of updates
notes.content:
In order to celebrate our release we want to make a little announcement!

We made Give Me Your Coins with constant grow in mind and right now we want to show you what we meant. Since the moment of release and until next Thursday every day we will be adding new levels to the game. Some of them will challenge you reaction and some will tease new elements (enemies and obstacles) that we will add to the game.

New level has been already added last night. And today you will receive another one!
